profile_text.body:
Huawei is a global provider of information and communications technology infrastructure and smart devices, founded in 1987 and headquartered in Shenzhen. The company describes its mission as bringing digital connectivity to every person, home, and organization in pursuit of what it calls a fully connected, intelligent world.

On the AI side, Huawei develops PanGu, a Chinese foundation model tracked in the chat and general large language model category. The model is optimized for Huawei's own Ascend chip hardware, and the site's records note that cross-border data review is advised for users considering deployment outside China.
